what: A 10rem translucent stage-color circle (white 1px border) trails the mouse, moving .1 of the remaining distance each frame, and turns on in .6s only over spots with data-cursor such as photo cards. The text inside (”more”) rises from below one letter at a time at .03s intervals over .3s. It turns off the same way when leaving the spot. The system cursor stays as is

options.pick: CSS selector to turn on, default [data-cursor] — data-cursor="dark" The filled circle gets darker

use:
more
· data-cursor on photo cards

from.where: On every page, the more circle over photo cards and plan panels (original .cursor — lerp .1 · 10rem · opacity .6s · text .3s · .03s stagger)
